base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: endless grey corridors lined with identical filing drawers, labelled shelving, grey pipes and ventilation shafts. Lighting: flat grey fluorescent strip lights.
In the shot: Duggie, an enormous, lovable Golden Retriever with shining coin-gold fur smeared with bog mud and river silt, one blade of grass stuck to his head, extraordinarily long floppy ears that flap like wings, huge soulful golden-brown eyes, a giant wagging tail, and a small swarm of cartoon flies circling his head in tight synchronised formation; a gleaming, garden-shed-sized, pressurised transparent bubble with a faint pink rose-tinted shimmer and drifting rose petals inside, strapped to the Tomkin-Mobile's roof rack.
Camera: Low tracking shot down the corridor.
Action: The bubble pops open at the docking hatch and Duggie launches down the grey corridor in fast mode, a golden blur leaving muddy pawprints.
No dialogue.
Sound effects: bubble pop, skittering claws, excited barks, ambience of humming fluorescents, typewriter clacks, servo whirs.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
